descriptionHtml:
This role has been designed as ‘Hybrid’ with an expectation that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

HPE Operations is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.

Management Level Definition

Contributions have a sustained and meaningful impact on AI, Automation, and Analytics products, platforms, and services. Applies advanced subject‑matter expertise to solve complex and ambiguous business problems and is regarded as a product and domain expert. Partners closely with functional, technical, and delivery teams and participates in cross‑functional and enterprise initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment in determining product strategy, prioritization, and execution approach. May provide mentorship and product leadership to other product managers and team members.

Responsibilities

  • Leads and drives the end‑to‑end product strategy and operational roadmap for one or more AI, Automation, or Analytics products or platforms
  • Defines the value proposition, target customer segments, and business case, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and portfolio strategy.
  • Synthesizes business and operational needs into clear product requirements, features, and success metrics, leveraging deep understanding of customers, processes, and technology.
  • Advises key stakeholders on product and portfolio strategy across all lifecycle phases, including planning, development, launch, scaling, optimization, and retirement.
  • Owns and prioritizes the product backlog, balancing innovation, scalability, technical debt, risk, and user experience.
  • Mentors junior product managers and provides thought leadership on product management standards and best practices.
  • Ensures adherence to Organization & Enterprise AI governance including Responsible AI principles, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Leads product launches, adoption strategies, and lifecycle management, including post‑launch performance monitoring and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates across the value chain—including engineering, architecture, data science, UX, security, PMO and operations—to enable successful product delivery and adoption
  • Tracks and communicates product performance, adoption, and business value realization, enabling data‑driven decisions.
  • Mentors junior product managers and provides thought leadership on product management standards and best practices.

What you need to Bring :-

Education And Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in computer science, engineering or related field of study. MBA or advanced degree in computer science or engineering preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in product management, digital transformation, platform ownership, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated exposure to AI, Automation and Analytics
  • Experience working in enterprise‑scale, governed environments.
  • Technical understanding and knowledge of the relevant industry.

Knowledge And Skills

  • Expert team skills and ability to cross functionally drive/influence work through others, ability to mentor and lead teams to achieve results for complex, ambiguous projects.
  • Strong product strategy, roadmap planning, and lifecycle management skills.
  • Advanced business and financial acumen, including value realization and outcome‑based measurement
  • Ability to translate complex business problems into scalable product capabilities
  • Technical understanding of AI, automation, or analytics solutions and ability to enable informed product decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills, including executive‑level engagement
  • Expert business acumen and knowledge of root cause analysis and problem detection.

Additional Skills

Cross Domain Knowledge, Customer Engagement, Design Thinking, Development Fundamentals, DevOps, Go-to-Market Expertise, Partner Management, Product Lifecycle Management, Security-First Mindset, Strategic Pricing, Strategy Creation, User Experience (UX), Value Creation, Vendor Management

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Please note that Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), its direct and indirect subsidiaries and affiliated companies, and its authorized recruitment agencies/vendors will never charge a candidate a registration fee, hiring fee, or any other fee in connection with its recruitment and hiring process. We also never request personal information such as back account details, Social Security numbers, or national IDs via social media or chat applications.

All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. Any reliance on fraudulent communication is at the individual’s own risk, and HPE disclaims legal liability for any resulting damages. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Josys

Josys is a fast-growing B2B SaaS startup on a mission to simplify and automate IT operations for the modern workplace. Backed by $218M in Series A & B funding and a successful launch in Japan, we’re expanding globally with a footprint in 9 countries and a cutting-edge tech hub in Bengaluru, India.

Spun off from RAKSUL (a Forbes Startup of the Year), Josys offers an all-in-one platform for SaaS and device management, giving IT teams 360° visibility and powerful automation—from employee onboarding to offboarding.

With remote work and SaaS sprawl on the rise, Josys helps businesses cut IT costs by up to 75%, boost security, and stay compliant—all while making IT teams super efficient.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to join Josys and help shape the future of AI-Powered SaaS management.

As a Senior Product Manager at Josys, you’ll play a critical role in building a user-centric B2B SaaS product that streamlines IT SaaS operations, drives automation, and delivers tangible value to enterprises. You’ll own key product areas, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and lead initiatives from discovery to launch. This is a high-impact role where you’ll influence product strategy, prioritize what matters most, and ensure we ship solutions that scale.

Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

As a Senior Product Manager At Josys, You Will

  • Understand market trends & user needs to identify meaningful customer pain points, and translate them into intuitive, scalable product solutions.
  • Break down complex problem statements into actionable, incremental product delivery.
  • Own quarterly planning and roadmap creation for your product domain, setting clear short-term and long-term objectives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success teams to define product requirements and drive end-to-end execution.
  • Conduct customer interviews and analyze feedback to uncover insights that inform product decisions, enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate features and ensure the product meets user expectations before launch.
  • Track adoption and usage of delivered features, gather user feedback and data insights, and drive iterative improvements to maximize product impact.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, or related field. MBA is a plus.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, particularly in the B2B SaaS domain.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with a keen eye for detail.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to lead and align cross-functional teams to drive shared product success
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a continuous learning mindset and a passion for keeping up with emerging technologies and industry trends.

title: Product Localisation Lead - India
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

  • Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages.
  • Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives.
  • Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion.
  • Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages.
  • Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions.
  • Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product
  • Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region.
  • Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs.

Qualifications

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company.
  • Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption.
  • Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams.
  • Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments.
  • A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing.
  • Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design.

Additional Information

About the Group/Team

Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.

In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.

About The Role/Specialty

As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.

This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today

At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.

In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.

While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!

You need to be a HODLer of these

  • 4-6+ years of relevant product management experience
  • At least 1 year of experience in building and creating product strategy/roadmap.
  • Strong grasp of user centered design process
  • Well-rounded interpersonal skills, and experience interacting with diverse personalities
  • MBA degree from a tier 1/2 business school
  • Bachelo's degree in technology or engineering from a tier 1,/ school

You will be mining through these tasks

  • Role is at an intersection of Payments/Banking rails and Compliance and will need to work closely with senior product managers of these two squads.
  • Manage the focus area for Fund Sources (Banks, On-Ramp Partners), KYC, AML and overall on-ramp/off-ramp rails.
  • Create a roadmap for the enhancements / addition to the product portfolio based on extensive data crunching and clearly defined KPIs and objectives
  • Responsible for delivering critical projects with crucial timelines and significant business impact.
  • Managing and executing decisions about the high-level technical architecture, product processes / automation and UI/UX designs of the project
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across functions to understand the user problem and their needs and formulate achievable requirements for development teams
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth.
  • Person would be willing to write technical PRD’s and work with engineering team and design team and execute the product roadmap
  • The growth path for this role (APM / PM role) can be into a PM/ SPM in either core Payments or Compliance team, based on performance, need of the org and also choice of the candidate.
  • Candidates should have prior product experience in KYC funnels OR Payment Gateway OR Risk/AML. Working with 3P tools like Signzy/Karza OR banking partners is BIG PLUS.

Are you the one? Our missing block

  • You are knowledge-hungry when it comes to VDA and Web3, always eager to dive deeper and stay ahead in this evolving space.
  • The world of Web3 and VDA excites you, fueling your curiosity and driving you to explore new opportunities within this dynamic landscape.
  • You act like an owner, constantly striving for excellence, impact, and tangible results in everything you do.
  • You embrace a ‘We over Me’ mindset, growing individually while fostering the growth of those around you.
  • Change is your catalyst, igniting your passion to build and innovate.
  • You think outside the box, unbound by limitations or doubt, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Perks That Empower You

Our benefits are designed to make a lasting impact on your life, giving you the freedom to create a work-life balance that truly suits you.﻿﻿

  • Design Your Own Benefit: Tailor your perk package to fit your unique needs. Whether you’re eyeing a new gadget or welcoming a furry friend into your life, our flexible benefits ensure that you can prioritize what matters most to you.
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: We believe in the power of well-being. Take the time you need to recharge, knowing that your health is our priority. With unlimited wellness leaves, you can return refreshed, ready to build and grow.
  • Mental Wellness Support: Your mental health is as important as your professional growth. Benefit from access to health experts, free counseling sessions, monthly wellness workshops, and regular team outings, all designed to help you stay balanced and connected.
  • Bi-Weekly Learning Sessions: These sessions are more than just updates—they’re opportunities to fuel your growth. Stay ahead with the latest industry knowledge, sharpen your skills, and accelerate your career in an ever-evolving landscape.

title: Group Product Manager-Lead Management & Conversion
descriptionHtml:
The Role As a Group Product Manager-Lead Management &conversion, you will own the product systems that sit at the heart of company's lead-to-sales visit conversion engine. This is a senior, hands-on role with direct accountability for outcomes across one of the company’s most commercially critical domains - converting qualified intent into a scheduled, completed visit. The role requires operating close to real-world conversion constraints while maintaining clarity across multiple products and teams. Product decisions here directly affect lead conversion rates, LRM team productivity, and the quality and volume of visits that feed the sales engine. Success depends on sharp analytical judgment, the ability to build structure where little exists, and the discipline to turn a complex, intervention-heavy presales motion into a system that scales reliably as the business grows.


Scope & Ownership


● Own a portfolio of presales-facing products and business problem areas - lead scoring and prioritisation, intervention orchestration, LRM workflow tooling, and funnel conversion metrics. ● Build and own lead scoring capability - define what signals predict conversion, distinguish correlation from causation, and work with engineering and data teams to translate that into a scoring model that drives prioritisation decisions in real time.

● Own the intervention logic that determines how, when, and through which channel the LRM team engages each lead - and systematically improve conversion outcomes through better orchestration.

● Own the CRM redesign and workflow extension - understand the current system deeply (from the ground up), identify where workflows have outgrown the system, and rebuild it to support current workflows and new acquisition channels reliably.

● Identify and address recurring inefficiencies, rework, and escalations across the lead-to-visit journey through better system and product design.

● Set priorities across product areas, ensuring focus on the highest-leverage opportunities for conversion efficiency and LRM team productivity.

● Drive end-to-end problem solving - from framing and discovery through execution, post-launch iteration, and automation.

● Coach PMs, raising the bar on problem framing, solution quality, and decision-making.

● Partner with business and engineering teams to balance near-term delivery with foundational improvements required for scale.


What Success Requires


● 8–11+ years of product management experience, ideally in inside sales systems, lead management, growth infrastructure, or similarly conversion-focused domains.

● Strong analytical instinct with a genuine point of view on lead scoring - knows what signals to look at, separate predictive signals from noise, and validate a scoring model.

● Analytics-heavy PM background preferred - comfortable working with data directly, defining instrumentation requirements, and reasoning from first principles about conversion mechanics. ● Hands-on experience with AI-driven product features - voice bots, recommendation systems, automated intervention logic, or similar.

● Comfort building structure from scratch; brings structure to ambiguous environments.

● Strong product judgment with the ability to reason across conversion mechanics, workflow constraints, and downstream data dependencies simultaneously.

● Ability to operate at multiple altitudes - hands-on problem solving as well as shaping priorities across a product portfolio.

● Demonstrated capability to lead, coach, and hold a high bar for PMs and cross-functional teams.

● Excellent stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior sales and engineering leaders through clarity and credibility

title: Sr. Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Join Itron as a Product Manager and help shape the future of clean energy. We're looking for a collaborative, systems-minded leader to help evolve our Distributed Intelligence platform, which is a key enabler in building a more sustainable, reliable, and customer-centric electric grid. In this role, you’ll be an active participant in developing software to increase grid resiliency, integrate renewable energy sources, and improve real-time grid operations. The Distributed Intelligence platform serves Itron’s Grid Edge Intelligence applications with a scalable, interoperable, and thoughtfully designed system for managing application deployments and integrating data from multiple sources. As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll define core capabilities for how to deliver software and analytics at the grid edge, and play a key role in unifying platform services across multiple grid management use cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape and manage product requirements for Itron’s Distributed Intelligence Enterprise Application Center, which manages utility software applications running at the grid edge.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including engineering, architecture, and implementation—to deliver solutions that are aligned with technical, operational, and customer needs.
  • Contribute to platform software architecture strategy, and design, including performance, normalization, and support for scalable software services.
  • Define how grid edge data is governed, managed, and distributed, to support utility data analytics and artificial intelligence / AI use cases.
  • Support and troubleshoot customer software deployments and migrations, while creating and maintaining technical documentation and solution guidelines.
  • Engage in product discovery to ensure development is grounded in user needs, market insights, and utility goals

Required Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical product management, solution architecture, or energy software development
  • Experience and understanding of distributed software systems such as IoT/internet of things, or utility metering.
  • Adept at evangelizing and driving cross-functional consensus across internal groups and external customers.
  • Understanding of data management and database design principles.
  • Exposure to utility operations systems (e.g., AMI, ADMS, GIS, CIS), or similar from a related field.
  • Strong and flexible communication skills, able to communicate with both a technical and sales audience interchangeably.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, energy systems, or related field

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Previous utility industry experience
  • Understanding of cloud-native platforms and microservices architectures
  • Awareness of cybersecurity best practices for energy systems
  • Experience working in Agile environments and using tools like Microsoft ADS, Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps

Master’s degree in technical or energy-related discipline is a plus

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

The Distributed Intelligence platform serves Itron’s Grid Edge Intelligence applications with a scalable, interoperable, and thoughtfully designed system for managing application deployments and integrating data from multiple sources. As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll define core capabilities for how to deliver software and analytics at the grid edge, and play a key role in unifying platform services across multiple grid management use cases.

Key Responsibilities



- Shape and manage product requirements for Itron’s Distributed Intelligence Enterprise Application Center, which manages utility software applications running at the grid edge.
- Partner with cross-functional teams—including engineering, architecture, and implementation—to deliver solutions that are aligned with technical, operational, and customer needs.
- Contribute to platform software architecture strategy, and design, including performance, normalization, and support for scalable software services.
- Define how grid edge data is governed, managed, and distributed, to support utility data analytics and artificial intelligence / AI use cases.
- Support and troubleshoot customer software deployments and migrations, while creating and maintaining technical documentation and solution guidelines.
- Engage in product discovery to ensure development is grounded in user needs, market insights, and utility goals 

Required Skills And Experience



- 5+ years of experience in technical product management, solution architecture, or energy software development
- Experience and understanding of distributed software systems such as IoT/internet of things, or utility metering.
- Adept at evangelizing and driving cross-functional consensus across internal groups and external customers.
- Understanding of data management and database design principles.
- Exposure to utility operations systems (e.g., AMI, ADMS, GIS, CIS), or similar from a related field.
- Strong and flexible communication skills, able to communicate with both a technical and sales audience interchangeably.
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, energy systems, or related field 

Preferred Skills And Experience



- Previous utility industry experience
- Understanding of cloud-native platforms and microservices architectures
- Awareness of cybersecurity best practices for energy systems
- Experience working in Agile environments and using tools like Microsoft ADS, Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps

Master’s degree in technical or energy-related discipline is a plus

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Manager – PM

Experience: 10+ years

Location: Bangalore (On-site)


Role Summary

You will be part of the Product Management team for the Lending portfolio, with a strong focus on Loan Management and Servicing platforms. This role involves working closely with the Product Director, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to design, build, and enhance scalable lending products used by banks and financial institutions globally.

Your primary responsibility will be to own and evolve product capabilities across the loan lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, configurability, and superior customer experience. You will translate complex lending domain requirements into clear product roadmaps and deliverables.


What Will You Do?

  • Define and execute product vision and roadmap for loan management systems aligned with business and market needs.
  • Own key lending modules including loan servicing, interest & fee management, repayments, collections, restructuring, and closures.
  • Act as the domain expert for retail, corporate, and SME lending, covering the full loan lifecycle.
  • Prioritize requirements based on customer value, regulatory needs, and commercial impact.
  • Collaborate with engineering, QA, UX, sales, and implementation teams to deliver high-quality releases.
  • Engage with customers and partners to capture real-world lending use cases and support pre-sales discussions.
  • Create PRDs, user stories, and functional documentation in Agile environments (Jira, Confluence).
  • Track product performance post-release and drive continuous improvements.


Skills & Qualifications Required

  • 10+ years of product management experience in BFSI lending or loan management platforms.
  • Strong experience in B2B enterprise software products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology (B.Tech or equivalent).
  • Deep expertise in loan lifecycle management, including EMI/interest calculations, collections, delinquency, restructuring, and closures.
  • Exposure to retail, corporate, SME, or Islamic lending is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, databases, configurable platforms, and Agile tools (Jira, Confluence).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives with an ownership-driven mindset.

title: Senior Product Manager - Payments Platform / Payment Framework
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for defining, delivering, and scaling core payment‑processing capabilities across global card‑present and card‑not‑present channels.

This role owns end‑to‑end product management for a defined set of payment platform capabilities, ensuring consistency, scalability, and alignment across gateways, processors, schemes, and downstream services. The Senior Manager partners closely with engineering, architecture, operations, risk, compliance, finance, and commercial teams to deliver high‑quality payment capabilities aligned with platform standards and regulatory requirements.

As a senior individual contributor, this role plays a key part in quarterly planning, roadmap execution, and cross‑team alignment within the Payment Processing Product Management organization and the broader Visa Acceptance Platform.

Payments Domain Expertise

  • Strong working knowledge of payment acceptance, processing, and orchestration, including authorization, settlement, tokenization, network rules, and payment‑scheme behaviors
  • Experience working with acquiring, gateway processing, issuer behaviors, and optionality across payment rails (card, wallets, A2A, alternative payments)
  • Familiarity with fraud‑management concepts (e.g., 3DS, routing strategies) is highly desirable

Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution

  • Contribute to and execute product strategy for assigned payment platform capabilities, including capability design and scaling considerations
  • Identify customer and market needs across merchants, PSPs, acquirers, and alternative payment methods
  • Translate customer, partner, and regulatory inputs into a clear, actionable roadmap/epic/features for payment flows and platform enhancements

Product Definition & Delivery

  • Define detailed product requirements, epics, features, process flows, and business rules for complex payment capabilities
  • Own cross‑functional readiness for assigned capabilities, including operational procedures, risk/compliance alignment, partner onboarding, and performance metrics
  • Participate in agile ceremonies as needed to ensure shared understanding and delivery against product goals
  • Ensure end‑to‑end payment experiences are well‑defined, including retries, fallbacks, routing logic, error handling, and user experience considerations

Data‑Driven Decision Making

  • Partner with analytics and operations teams to define KPIs, dashboards, and monitoring tools that support prioritization and performance tracking
  • Analyze trends such as authorization declines, fraud rates, routing effectiveness, and cost‑to‑serve to inform product improvements
  • Commercialization & Go‑to‑Market
  • Support development of value propositions, pricing inputs, merchant‑facing narratives, and readiness materials
  • Collaborate with sales, program management, finance, legal, compliance, UX, and partners to support go‑to‑market execution
  • Participate in merchant and partner engagements by clearly articulating product capabilities, differentiation, and roadmap direction

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

  • 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 6 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • Minimum of 5 years of product management experience in payment processing domain and API‑based products.
  • Strong expertise in payments processing, including gateways, acquiring, scheme rules, lifecycle flows, and regulatory considerations
  • Experience defining API contracts, platform capabilities, and contributing to longer‑term product architecture decisions
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with a bias toward scalable, reusable product solutions

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Product Manager – Tech, Alexa Daily Essentials
descriptionHtml:
Description

Want to transform the way people interact with Alexa leveraging generative AI? Come join the team that is building the next-generation AI-assistant that gets things done across Timers, Alarms, Reminders, Calendars, Recipes, and News on Alexa devices. In this role, you'll drive product strategy and initiatives for a dedicated area within our Alexa Productivity Essentials team focused on driving engaging, high-traffic productivity scenarios for millions of customers worldwide. You’ll work with CX, science and engineering partners to build our next phase in making Alexa the world’s best personal assistant. The role presents an enormous opportunity to impact the customer experience for products that are used every day by people you know. We are looking for someone who is passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, has demonstrated product leadership skills, and thrives in an environment where they collaborate closely with colleagues across product, design, research, science and engineering.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive the architectural and platform vision for the product space
  • Own the roadmap and translate customer requirement into technical specifications
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineering managers to drive and prioritize the roadmaps and make technical decisions and tradeoffs connected to your product space
  • Recognize and scope new customer opportunities, translating customer needs into business and system requirements
  • Drive project schedules from design to launch
  • Make the right trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
  • Clearly communicate goals, metrics, roles, and responsibilities to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with senior leaders within Alexa and throughout Amazon

A day in the life

You will own part of the Alexa Productivity Essentials initiative, defining the vision, strategy, product and tech roadmap across experiences loved and used by millions of customers. You will work closely with science, design, research and engineering partners to craft experiences to help customers more seamlessly get more done, and translate that vision into a product roadmap. You will also partner with product teams across Alexa to define how our experiences leverage new innovations in generative AI to help customers accomplish their goals. This is a “Think Big” role where you get to craft the vision and strategy for how customers experience our features across a range of Alexa touch-points.

About The Team

We’re a collaborative team that works closely together, fostering a creative and fun dynamic. We build Alexa experiences that customers connect with on a daily basis, connecting to the essential services that become part of their daily rhythm. The ideal candidate for this role will possess a strong product background with a penchant for cross-team collaboration across business, technical, and design counterparts. They will have deep technical skills and customer centric mindset with a history of launching notable products.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams
  • Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
  • Previous experience building products that leverage A.I., Machine Learning, Speech/Natural Language Understanding

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Product Manager, IN DEX
descriptionHtml:
Description

Amazon India is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive delivery experience innovations as the India leader. This is a high-impact role with full ownership of initiatives that directly shape customer delivery experience and Amazon India's delivery economics across millions of orders. You will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for India-specific delivery experience innovations and you will drive adoption of both developed and under-development products to extract maximum value, partnering closely with partners across supply chain, operations, categories and engineering.

We are looking for a strong PM who can dive deep into promise systems, delivery operations, and customer experience, write detailed PRFAQs/PRDs, and deliver features in complex, ambiguous environments. Proficiency with AI-powered tools for rapid experimentation is highly valued. The role offers significant visibility with IES DEX leadership and IN stores leadership.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct responsibility for driving product adoption and value extraction across operations, supply chain, categories, and technology teams
  • Opportunity to leverage AI tools to accelerate product development cycles and experimentation velocity
  • Opportunity to drive India-specific innovations in delivery communication and promise systems
  • Significant cross-functional impact requiring strong stakeholder engagement and change management
  • Direct influence on customer delivery experience for millions of Amazon India customers
  • High visibility with senior leadership across India business and WW DEX teams

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive adoption of developed and under-development products to extract maximum value through strategic stakeholder engagement across operations, supply chain, categories, WW teams, and technology
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate experimentation cycles including rapid PRFAQ writing, prototype development, data analysis, and hypothesis validation
  • Use AI-powered tools to quickly iterate product concepts, create mockups, analyze customer feedback, and generate insights from operational data
  • Build and execute adoption strategies including training, documentation, stakeholder alignment, and change management to ensure products deliver intended business impact
  • Drive India-specific innovations to improve delivery experience, checkout experience and pricing/promotions strategy for millions of India customers.
  • Build deep understanding of promise systems and enable optimal ship option configurations to maximize utilization of available network capacity and capabilities
  • Define and track key performance indicators including delivery reliability metrics, intercept rates, revenue recovery, customer satisfaction, and product adoption rates

About The Team

As part of Amazon's India Delivery Experience (IN DEX) team, we work on some of the most challenging customer experience problems in India's complex delivery landscape. We partner with operations teams, supply chain, technology, business teams, and WW DEX to build innovative solutions that drive real impact on delivery reliability and customer satisfaction. With a focus on India-specific innovations, we translate customer pain points into robust, scalable products that deliver tangible value to customers and the Amazon India business.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
  • Experience in using statistical analysis to identify issues or opportunities for improvement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience leading and defining requirements and driving these across diverse organizations
  • Proficiency with AI tools for rapid experimentation including PRFAQ writing, prototyping, data analysis, and insight generation. Demonstrated ability to use AI-powered tools to accelerate product development cycles and increase experimentation velocity
  • Ability to analyze large datasets; proficiency in SQL or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Sr.Product Manager - Tech
descriptionHtml:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and carry products that our customers want and enjoy, while ensuring that customers are safe and get safe products from Amazon. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic and driven people. If you'd like to help us build an environment where our customer's safety is paramount, where we enable our customers to find and buy anything online, and where we ensure that we maintain and enhance customer trust on Amazon, then this is your chance to be part of a challenging and strategic initiative.

We're looking for a strong Senior Product Manager - Technical to join our team in Bangalore, India. This role requires exceptional technical depth in Generative AI, as you'll partner with Applied Scientists and Engineering teams to build next-generation AI-powered compliance and safety solutions. You should have strong technical problem-solving skills, product management expertise in AI/ML domains, excellent communication skills, and deep understanding of how to evaluate, deploy, and scale LLM-based systems in production environments. You should also possess the ability to influence people across the organization from tech leadership to business managers by creating win-win solutions, and the desire to be an individual contributor driving Amazon's next generation of AI-powered safety technology.

This role will report into the global product team that enables Trustworthy shopping experience at Amazon and ensures Safety and Compliance across Amazon stores. A primary focus of this role is defining the product strategy and roadmap for GenAI applications that automate compliance workflows, enhance decision-making accuracy, and scale our safety operations globally. You will work closely with Applied Scientists to evaluate LLM capabilities, design human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems, and establish AI governance frameworks that ensure responsible deployment of AI models in high-stakes compliance scenarios.

This role is inherently cross-functional—the professional will work closely with various partner teams across Amazon including Applied Science, Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Safety and Compliance to bring AI-powered products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our existing tech products and features. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, technically sophisticated in AI/ML domains, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines while managing complex stakeholder alignment.

You should be passionate about retail, supply chain, consumer business, and building meaningful AI-powered products that transform how Amazon ensures customer safety at scale. Prior experience working in product management for AI/ML products, managing GenAI roadmaps, and working in retail or supply chain environments is preferred.

Key job responsibilities

GenAI Product Strategy & Execution

Define and own the 3-5 year product vision and roadmap for GenAI-powered compliance automation, balancing innovation with operational excellence

Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to evaluate LLM capabilities for safety and compliance workflows, including accuracy, latency, cost, and safety guardrails

Design and launch human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems that combine AI automation with human judgment for high-stakes compliance decisions

Establish metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI model performance, including precision/recall, false positive rates, cost per decision, and operational impact

Assess emerging LLM technologies (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.) and recommend strategic investments for Amazon's compliance tech stack

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

Work with internal customers to understand their use cases, pain points, and requirements for AI-assisted compliance workflows

Collaborate with partner engineering teams to drive product roadmaps for compliance and safety, ensuring technical excellence and scalability

Challenge Science teams on model architecture decisions, technical trade-offs, and design choices to ensure optimal product outcomes

Address bottlenecks, provide customer input, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints

Understand and articulate the technical reasons behind product architecture decisions and recognize when technical design limits future innovation

Cross-Functional Program Management

Partner with multiple tech, product, and operations teams across multiple locations with varying priorities to ensure timely delivery of AI solutions

Clarify and drive project commitments as well as establish and maintain clear chains of accountability across Science, Engineering, and Operations

Drive adoption of GenAI solutions across global compliance operations through change management, training, and stakeholder engagement

Manage complex initiatives across numerous business models and create certainty out of ambiguity while maintaining firm grasp over operational, financial, and technical aspects

Data-Driven Decision Making

Query and analyze data to derive insightful findings that inform product strategy and prioritization

Define success metrics for AI model deployment including business impact, operational efficiency gains, and customer experience improvements

Conduct cost-benefit analyses for GenAI investments, including model training costs, inference costs, and operational savings

AI Governance & Responsible AI

Establish AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices for compliance use cases

Design evaluation protocols for model safety, bias detection, and fairness in automated decision-making

Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure AI solutions meet regulatory requirements and ethical standards

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About The Role

We are looking for a customer-obsessed, analytics-driven Lead Product Manager to shape the future of our digital experience and commerce platform used by airlines as their primary web channel for customer engagement, shopping, booking, servicing, and post-purchase experiences.

This role will lead initiatives focused on building a platform thats highly customizable by our customers, customer experience, integrations, and scalable commerce capabilities. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, delivery and external customer stakeholders to deliver highly configurable, enterprise-grade solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical product management skills with the ability to drive alignment across complex programs and customer-facing initiatives.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive product roadmap and execution for digital commerce and customer experience capabilities.
  • Lead modernization initiatives across integrations and extensibility frameworks
  • Partner closely with engineering, architects, external customer and delivery teams to deliver scalable and configurable platform capabilities
  • Drive roadmap prioritization balancing customer needs, scalability, technical investment, and delivery timelines
  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear product requirements, epics, and user stories
  • Lead customer and stakeholder discussions to align on roadmap, priorities, and delivery strategy
  • Identify delivery risks early and drive mitigation planning across cross-functional teams
  • Support strategic customer engagements, solutioning discussions, and product positioning initiatives
  • Influence long-term platform and ecosystem strategy in partnership with engineering leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS, digital commerce, platform products, or related technology domains
  • Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and scalable platform architectures
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across business and technical teams
  • Experience leading large-scale modernization or transformation initiatives
  • Strong UX and customer journey mindset with experience partnering deeply with design and research teams
  • Strong experience using analytics and experimentation to drive product decisions and improve conversion, engagement, or operational metrics
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level communication
  • Strong analytical and prioritization skills with experience balancing roadmap scope, timelines, and technical constraints
  • Experience working in Agile product development environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in travel, hospitality, loyalty, or other transaction-heavy digital platforms
  • Familiarity with configurable or white-label platform models
  • Experience building platform capabilities used by enterprise customers or external developers
  • Understanding of modern commerce ecosystems and customer experience platforms

Why Join Us

You’ll have the opportunity to shape a highly scalable digital platform used by airline customers globally. This role offers significant ownership, cross-functional leadership exposure, and the ability to influence the future direction of a modern commerce ecosystem.

title: Group Product Manager - Payments | India [Head of Product, India]
descriptionHtml:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Group Product Manager, Adyen India

As the Group Product Manager for India, you will be a pivotal member of the Adyen India Leadership Team. You will define and execute the product strategy for one of Adyen’s highest-growth regions, ensuring our merchants can expand their reach through locally preferred and innovative payment methods.

This role sits within the global Payments Group. You will collaborate closely with the India Country Head, the Head of Engineering, and global product groups to build the payment engine of the future. You are not just a strategist; you act as the external face of Adyen’s holistic product innovation, engaging with regulators, industry bodies, and C-level executives at the leading merchants to shape the future of the Indian fintech landscape.

What You Will Do

  • Formulate and lead a strategic vision that balances technical acquiring capabilities (eg. Cards, UPI) with the end-to-end merchant experience, ensuring our solutions solve real-world customer problems rather than just meeting technical requirements.
  • You will act as the owner for the India product suite, moving beyond technical delivery to partner with our GTM teams to ensure the commercial viability and market fit of our entire offering. This includes partnering with commercial leaders to understand merchant pain points holistically—from onboarding and pricing to support and retention, ensuring Adyen’s value proposition is seamless across all touchpoints.
  • Serve as the domain expert for the Indian market, identifying new acquiring capabilities and navigating complex regulatory requirements.
  • Work with engineering on resource planning and execution, balancing high-stakes performance and scalability with the rollout of new features.
  • You will build and lead a team of product managers focused on product development for Adyen India, both in your specific areas and with a strong focus on cross-team and solution synergies across Adyen globally.
  • You will work across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Product teams and closely collaborate with commercial teams such as Sales/AMs, and Product Marketing.
  • You combine strategic leadership with a willingness to dive into the details when needed, taking end-to-end ownership to drive clarity in scope, priorities, and requirements

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of shipping high-quality products at scale. Experience in the Indian fintech or financial services sector is preferred.
  • You have autonomously delivered impact by leading and leveraging a portfolio of product managers across product areas.
  • You are effective in finding, growing, leading and retaining talent in product management (5+ years of management experience)
  • You possess a "founder’s mentality," and are comfortable operating at the intersection of product, sales, and operations, and you use data-driven insights to make high-stakes trade-offs that benefit the long-term health of Adyen’s merchant customers.
  • Deep knowledge of the Indian payments ecosystem, including card schemes, UPI, digital wallets, and local "money flow" regulations.
  • Proven ability to translate complex merchant needs into a comprehensive product roadmap that creates a "multiplier effect" across the business, driving both top-line growth and operational efficiency.
  • You succeed in creating a multiplier effect, in connecting with other leaders on opportunities and scaling impactful ways of working.
  • Ability to guide cross-functional teams using analytics to not only drive product decisions but also to quantify the business value and ROI of our localized offerings.
  • Action-Oriented- A relentless bias toward action and tangible outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • You have solid and inspiring communication skills to interact with both internal and external stakeholders as well as the teams working on and contributing to Adyen India.
  • You love to act as a mentor and help guide talent to make optimal decisions.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Bengaluru office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Progression Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Description

As a Senior Product Manager on the Lifecycle Experiences team, you will own the product vision and execution roadmap for our Progression Intelligence charter. This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.

You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.

This is a deeply technical role that requires equal comfort with ML systems, API architecture, and product strategy. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and marketing stakeholders to ship systems that directly delight millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year product roadmap for Progression Intelligence, including the phased migration of core ML models and decisioning systems onto a unified orchestration platform
  • Define technical requirements and integration specifications for connecting rewards optimization, propensity modeling, causal incrementality measurement, and promotion configuration systems into a cohesive, real-time decisioning layer
  • Partner with applied scientists to translate model outputs into actionable product features - including reward denomination optimization, next-best-action recommendations, and personalized campaign triggers
  • Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact
  • Define and own success metrics for the Progression Intelligence platform - including model coverage, decisioning latency, incremental lift, and customer settlement outcomes
  • Write product requirement documents and participate in technical design reviews, and lead alignment across engineering, science, and business stakeholders
  • Represent the Progression Intelligence charter in senior leadership reviews, including weekly business reviews and annual planning cycles

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Microsoft AI is a customer-first organization building AI powered products in service of our customer’s business goals. The world is changing rapidly during this AI platform shift and we need Product Managers who can live in the future and bring back clarity to the present to guide our work.

As a Product Manager for Microsoft AI, you will help businesses that want to grow and expand their business using our products, data, and services through advertising and new business models that unlock AI-first products. This role requires consistent knowledge and deep awareness of the emerging AI industry to develop new products as we have the freedom and flexibility to use the best technology in service of our customer.

We work within Microsoft AI (MAI), an organization responsible for Copilot, Bing, Edge, MSN, and other AI-first products. The organization has all the ingredients needed for success with Product, Engineering, Research, and Go To Market functions partnering as peers with shared goals. This enables close collaboration and rapid decision making.

One of the reasons Microsoft AI consistently brings innovative products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. We work closely with talented engineers, designers, marketers, creatives, customers, partners, and go-to-market teams to design and develop products tailored for our customer’s benefit. We run lean, obsess about users, and make decisions based on evidence. We ship regularly, so your work will have real and immediate impact. It’s a time of huge change in the AI landscape, and this role will put you right in the heart of it.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

  • Drive building world-class AI applications that will delight consumers and deliver business results .
  • Own a product area and be responsible for understanding user needs and behaviors, defining product requirements, managing end-to-end product development, launches and iterations.
  • Find a path to get things done despite roadblocks to get your work into the hands of users quickly and iteratively.
  • Enjoy working in a fast-paced, customer-first, product development cycle.
  • Translate business goals into strategy, user experience and technical requirements in close collaboration with UX, Data Science, Engineering, AI research, and Product Marketing teams.
  • Define goals and performance indicators, set up and oversee experiments, measure success with data and research.
  • Collaborate effectively and communicate clearly with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to build exceptional consumer-grade applications.
  • Embody our Culture and Values.  

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Experience leading AI product teams and building AI products.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 15+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Experience leading product teams building products in advertising, privacy, conversational AI, generative AI, or transferrable skills.
  • Experience building consumer products leveraging Machine Learning or Large Language Models.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing requirements and deadlines. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate and contribute to a positive, inclusive work environment, fostering knowledge sharing and growth within the team.
  • Experience with data analytics and experimentation tools. Working knowledge of SQL and coding skills (Python, Javascript).
#MicrosoftAI

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

descriptionHtml:
Flexera saves customers billions of dollars in wasted technology spend. A pioneer in Hybrid ITAM and FinOps, Flexera provides award-winning, data-oriented SaaS solutions for technology value optimization (TVO), enabling IT, finance, procurement and cloud teams to gain deep insights into cost optimization, compliance and risks for each business service. Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology Blueprint™ in hybrid environments—from on-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud.

We’re transforming the software industry.  We’re Flexera.  With more than 50,000 customers across the world, we’re achieving that goal. But we know we can’t do any of that without our team. Ready to help us re-imagine the industry during a time of substantial growth and ambitious plans?  Come and see why we’re consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester and IDC as a category leader in the marketplace. Learn more at flexera.com

Job Description: Senior Product Manager for Data

About Flexera: Flexera is a leader in providing innovative solutions for technology asset management. Our comprehensive suite of products helps organizations maximize the value of their technology investments. We're committed to building a dynamic, inclusive environment where everyone can contribute to making an impact.

Role Overview: Flexera is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Product Manager to lead our Content capture and curation capabilities. This strategic role requires a blend of technical acumen, customer insight, and a deep understanding of integration ecosystems.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the product vision and strategy for the Flexera platform's content strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, marketing, and support to drive product development and go-to-market strategies.
  • Conduct market research to validate customer needs and ensure our integrations deliver compelling value propositions.
  • Develop user stories, define requirements, and prioritize the backlog to align with customer expectations and business goals.
  • Work closely with the development team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality features.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs to assess integration performance and inform product decisions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for the Flexera content, providing guidance and thought leadership both internally and externally.
  • Engage with customers and partners to gather feedback, refine product strategy, and identify new opportunities.
  • Maintain a keen understanding of industry trends, competition, and ServiceNow updates that may impact our integration capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of delivering successful integrations, preferably in SaaS or cloud-based environments.
  • Strong technical background with the ability to engage with engineers on detailed technical discussions.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or related ITSM products
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Experience in agile development environments and familiarity with product management tools and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges.
  • Willingness to travel and engage with customers, partners, and internal teams globally.

What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters innovation, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Competitive compensation package, including equity options and comprehensive benefits.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities in a company that values continuous learning.
  • The chance to work with a talented team on one of the most cutting-edge technology platforms in the industry.

Flexera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply and join our team

descriptionHtml:
Role Overview for Senior Product Manager (Acquisition & Monetisation):

As Senior Product Manager, you’ll own the product lifecycle end-to-end—from vision to execution. You’ll work with leadership to define the roadmap, drive data-backed decisions, and deliver impactful experiences for millions of users. This is a high-ownership role, requiring strategic thinking, strong execution, and deep empathy for users.


Key Responsibilities

● Product Vision & Strategy: Define and own product roadmap for your charter aligned with company goals.

● Data-Driven Decision Making: Leverage analytics, user research, and market insights to identify problems, opportunities and improve product KPIs.

● End-to-End Ownership: Lead the product lifecycle - from concept, requirements gathering, and prioritisation to launch and post-launch optimisation.

● User-Centric Design: Partner with UX/UI teams to deliver intuitive and delightful user experience.

● Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, and operations to execute product initiatives with confidence.

● Performance Optimisation: Monitor KPIs, and iterate to drive conversion, retention, and revenue.

● Market Awareness: Stay ahead of trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to maintain

product leadership.

What You Bring
