title: Senior Product Manager, AI & Data Science
descriptionHtml:
Why Choose Bottomline?

Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!

Product Manager – AI & Data Science

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 6-8 years

Role Summary

We are seeking a Product Manager with strong AI & Data Science product experience to drive AI-led innovation across our product portfolio. This is a strategic AI product management role, focused on AI vision, governance, research, and prioritization—not day-to-day delivery or sprint execution.

This PM will work horizontally across product lines, partnering with Product Line PMs and AI/Data Science/CTO engineering teams to ensure we invest in the right AI problems, apply responsible AI principles, and deliver high-impact, scalable AI features.

Key Responsibilities

AI Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and own the AI/Data Science product vision aligned to business outcomes.
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact AI use cases across business payments network, corporate payment solutions and banking solutions
  • Shape a multi‑quarter AI roadmap focused on measurable customer and business impact.

AI Governance & Responsible AI

  • Ensure AI initiatives comply with responsible AI principles (privacy, security, explainability, regulatory expectations).
  • Establish and run AI intake, prioritization, and review mechanisms with Product Line PMs and engineering.
  • Act as the central owner for AI product governance across teams.

Research & Solutioning

  • Lead problem discovery and solution research—customer pain points, data readiness, feasibility, and ROI.
  • Partner with AI/Data Science engineers to evaluate model approaches, trade-offs, and constraints.

Cross‑functional Leadership (No Sprint Ownership)

  • Collaborate with Product Line PMs who own execution and delivery.
  • Work closely with AI/Data Science, Data Platforms, Architecture and Legal/Compliance
  • Influence priorities through clarity, insight, and impact—without direct authority.

Impact & Measurement

  • Define success metrics for AI features (adoption, efficiency, revenue, risk reduction etc.).
  • Ensure AI investments deliver real customer and business outcomes, not just technical outputs.

Required Qualifications

  • 6–8 years of product management experience with hands-on AI/ML product exposure.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-powered enterprise or B2B SaaS products.
  • Strong understanding of applied ML concepts, data pipelines, and AI lifecycle.
  • Experience working in regulated or complex domains (FinTech, Payments, Banking preferred).
  • Strong stakeholder management, structured thinking, and written communication skills.
  • Experience operating effectively in matrixed, global organizations.

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Collections and SDK
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

Job Purpose

The Senior Product Manager (SPM) at Nielsen is an essential catalyst for innovation within the audience measurement landscape. In this role you will oversee the entire product lifecycle including validating product-market fit, executing the product vision, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver products that delight our customers.

To Be Successful In This Role You Will Need

  • Technical Empathy for SDK Consumers: Our clients are development teams at broadcasters and streaming services. The PM who succeeds here won't just write requirements - they'll think from the perspective of the engineer doing the integration. The ability to walk in a developer's shoes — without necessarily being a developer yourself — is the single most important differentiator in this role.
  • Measurement Domain Fluency: Nielsen's SDKs exist to feed the measurement engine. A PM who understands why each metadata field matters, how a misconfigured content ID corrupts a rating, or why latency on a ping matters for ad measurement will make far better prioritization decisions than one who treats the SDK as an abstract data pipe.
  • Proactive Client Partnership Over Reactive Support: Our clients have engineering teams with their own release cycles, compliance windows, and capacity constraints. A successful PM in this role anticipates them - publishing clear migration guides ahead of a version change, proactively reaching out to at-risk integrators, and building trust so clients treat Nielsen as a partner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the multi-platform SDK roadmap across Browser, iOS, Android, and Domless (CTV/OTT) surfaces, balancing client needs, platform constraints, and measurement accuracy.
  • Prioritize features, deprecations, and platform support decisions in collaboration with engineering leadership and Nielsen's measurement science teams.
  • Define and maintain a clear release cadence for SDK versions, ensuring backwards compatibility and a predictable integration lifecycle for external partners.
  • Drive the quality and completeness of SDK documentation, sample code, and integration guides published to the Nielsen SDKDOC knowledge base.
  • Partner with support engineers to triage and resolve integration issues, identifying patterns that inform product improvements or documentation updates.
  • Work with Nielsen's product and data science teams to ensure SDK instrumentation accurately captures signals needed for DCR, DTVR, and DAR measurement.
  • Represent the SDK team in broader product forums, communicating roadmap status, risks, and opportunities to senior stakeholders.
  • Maintain awareness of platform-level privacy policies (Apple ATT, Google Play data safety, browser cookie regulations) and proactively adapt the SDK roadmap to keep Nielsen compliant.
  • Own Privacy Policy maintenance within the SDK documentation and ensure all client-facing materials reflect current compliance requirements.
  • Track record of working directly with external clients or partners on technical integrations, including documentation, onboarding, and issue resolution.

Qualifications

Key Skills

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred
  • 4-7 years experience in product management of a data product.
  • Experience working in agile environments with distributed engineering teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical requirements for both engineering audiences and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated understanding of multi-platform software distribution — ideally including mobile (iOS/Android), web (JavaScript), and/or connected TV environments.
  • Knowledge of project and product management tools like Jira
  • Nimble with fail-fast mindset to drive rapid iterations of product development
  • Strong time management skills
  • A customer-first approach by anchoring and solving customer problems rapidly, aligning data-driven decisions with customer needs

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

  • Expertise in Identity resolution and methodologies: Drive the development of a high-fidelity identity graph. Design strategies that account for varying data quality and availability across global markets while solving for critical measurement and person / household level use cases.
  • Strategic privacy and compliance evolution: As the primary steward of the identity roadmap, you must partner with privacy/legal teams to navigate the shifting global privacy landscape and regulatory environment. You will evaluate third party providers for strategic alignment, respecting evolving laws while maximizing coverage and accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prior experience in Identity graphs and Data Interoperability is required. Familiarity with complex data methodologies including probabilistic vs deterministic matching and identity resolution
  • Define data governance and privacy standards for identity resolution across diverse datasets
  • Stay abreast of the evolving Identity and privacy landscape. Work with legal/privacy teams to incorporate requirements into the product roadmap.
  • Evaluate and manage third party identity providers to enhance the Nielsen graph’s reach and accuracy
  • Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners
  • Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding of Nielsen products to internal stakeholders.
  • Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact
  • Work closely with Data Science and engineering teams to deliver with quick time-to-market and optimal resources
  • Work with high profile customers to ensure they understand the methodologies used to build and deliver Identity graphs
  • Maintaining a prioritized backlog that aligns with available Engineering capacity and maps to an overall solution roadmap.
  • Set and track ROI goals for each product, ensuring they deliver value and align with broader business objectives
  • Track and enforce contractual commitments to inform product roadmap and prioritization

Qualifications

Key Skills

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred
  • 4-7 years experience in product management of a data product.
  • Prior experience with clean rooms (AWS, Snowflake, Habu, etc.) is a plus
  • Additional certifications in Product Management, Agile methodologies, or related areas can be advantageous
  • Knowledge of project and product management tools like Jira
  • Experience with big data analytics and data flows
  • Experience in writing technical specifications and technology requirements
  • Nimble with fail-fast mindset to drive rapid iterations of product development
  • Strong time management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills along with the ability to present effectively to upper management
  • A customer-first approach by anchoring and solving customer problems rapidly, aligning data-driven decisions with customer needs

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Salary range: Rs 2000000 - Rs 3500000 (ie INR 20-35 LPA)

Min Experience: 4+ years

Location: Bengaluru

JobType: full-time

You will operate at the crossroads of academic complexity and user-friendly product design, converting the requirements of administrators, faculty, and students into features that truly revolutionize institutional operations. You will work in close collaboration with teams from engineering, design, customer success, and sales to create a product that connects with institutions throughout India and internationally.

Requirements

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Take full ownership of and continuously enhance the product roadmap for the Academics vertical, encompassing aspects such as attendance, timetabling, curriculum management, course registration, class creation, LMS, feedback, surveys, and PhD/research modules
  • Prioritize features and improvements by integrating customer feedback, usage analytics, and current higher education institutional trends
  • Effectively balance immediate customer demands with the long-term vision for the platform, ensuring that all decisions support our growth goals
  • Lead regular discovery sessions with academic administrators, faculty members, and students from partner institutions to identify pain points and unmet requirements
  • Evaluate product usage data, support inquiries, and market insights to uncover gaps and new opportunities for products within the academics vertical
  • Collaborate closely with customer success and sales teams to incorporate the customer's perspective into every sprint and planning session
  • Convert complex academic workflows into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user stories that engineering and design teams can confidently implement
  • Facilitate agile processes including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of high-quality releases
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts across design, engineering, QA, and go-to-market teams to guarantee smooth launches of new features
  • Track adoption, engagement, and outcome metrics following product launches and rapidly iterate based on data and user feedback
  • Maintain a well-organized product backlog, prioritizing tasks that have the greatest impact
  • Serve as the main product liaison for academic module stakeholders, both internally (sales, customer success, engineering) and externally (institutional administrators and faculty)
  • Consistently communicate product progress, roadmap priorities, and release schedules clearly to leadership and cross-functional team members

Requirements

Must Haves

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in product management within enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a proven history of delivering B2B SaaS products from start to finish
  • Demonstrated capability to independently manage a product vertical—from initial discovery and roadmap development through execution and post-launch refinement
  • Deep understanding of academic workflows in higher education, including timetabling, curriculum management, learning management systems, attendance, and student lifecycle processes
  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, comfortable utilizing product analytics tools and translating data into actionable product enhancements
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to align cross-functional teams around a unified product vision
  • Practical experience working in agile environments, conducting sprint ceremonies, and managing product backlogs

Good to Have

  • Previous experience collaborating with Indian higher education institutions such as universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms like Moodle, Canvas, or proprietary systems, as well as academic ERP solutions
  • Experience using product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or equivalents
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Figma
  • Background in working with customer-facing teams—including sales, support, and customer success—to collect and act upon institutional feedback
  • A passion for the education sector and a sincere interest in enhancing outcomes for students and academic institutions

Must-have Skills

Product Manager, Product Roadmapping, SaaS

Good-to-have Skills

B2B, LMS, ERP

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial, driven Senior Product Manager to lead the charge on our next-generation AI Insights solutions. In this 0-to-1 role, you will operate with scrappy, startup-minded velocity within the stability and scale of a mid-sized enterprise environment.

You will not just be managing a roadmap; you will be building a product from the ground up that leverages machine learning and AI to deliver actionable, transformative insights to contact center operations. You are comfortable navigating the messiness of real-world data and the limitations of ML models in production, making tough tradeoff calls with incomplete information, and pivoting quickly when things aren't working.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Execution

  • Define and execute the 0-to-1 product strategy for Five9's AI-powered insights and analytics offerings

Navigate Ambiguity

  • Handle real-world data complexities, manage ML model limitations in production environments, and make critical product decisions even when data is incomplete

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Applied Science/ML, Design, and GTM functions to deliver superior products for our customers

Customer-Centric Iteration

  • Actively engage with customers and design partners to gather feedback, validate assumptions, and refine the product roadmap based on real-world usage and pain points

Market Leadership

  • Conduct competitive research and market analysis to identify new opportunities in AI/ML analytics and maintain a competitive edge

Ruthless Prioritization

  • Demonstrate a builder's instinct with strong opinions, loosely held. Know when to double down and possess a track record of confidently killing features or pivoting strategies that aren't working

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • MBA or Master’s in Data Science, Analytics, or related degrees is a plus

Professional Experience

  • 4+ years of comprehensive professional experience in SaaS Product Management
  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate adaptability and success across both agile, high-growth startup environments and established enterprise organizations

Product Leadership

  • A proven track record in a formal Product Management capacity, successfully delivering B2B SaaS solutions

Industry Expertise (Required)

  • Essential background in the Contact Center or Customer Experience (CX) industry coupled with direct experience building and shipping AI-driven products

Technical Acumen

  • Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle for ML-driven solutions, including data collection, model training tradeoffs, and analytics

Execution-Oriented

  • A highly autonomous operator capable of driving initiatives forward without relying on extensive operational support structures
  • Must be able to articulate and defend strategic decisions effectively and collaboratively

Critical Competencies

Successful candidates for this role will demonstrate:

Applied AI Proficiency

  • Practical experience managing the realities of LLMs and machine learning deployments, including addressing latency constraints, optimization, and accuracy challenges

Operational Excellence

  • A strong bias for action and a proven ability to translate high-level strategy into tangible, delivered products

Client Advocacy

  • A strong commitment to direct customer interaction and a willingness to engage continuously with clients to resolve challenges, gather feedback, and drive product adoption

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
01

Why this exists

What if the app that handles your home's money actually understood how homes work?

The Indian consumer payments stack is functionally solved. UPI works. Wallets work. What's not solved is how money actually moves between the people who live together — flatmates settling rent and groceries, partners managing a shared household, families coordinating around staff and bills and birthday gifts. The everyday money inside an Indian home is still a WhatsApp message and a mental note.

Fave is the bet that this changes — and that the company that wins shared money becomes the operating layer for a generation of Indian consumers.

We've built the beta. Real users, real spend, real signal. Now we need someone to own the product as it scales.

02

The role

You'd own the product end-to-end. Strategy, roadmap, ship cadence, the whole thing.

There's no PM org to inherit — you'll build it. There's no playbook for what we're doing — you'll write it. You'll partner with strong, opinionated peers leading engineering and marketing/design who already know the product cold. The job is to bring product judgment to a team that has nearly everything else.

This is not a managerial role with an IC ladder underneath it. You'll lead, but you'll also build. You'll write specs you actually want to write. You'll prototype a feature before scoping it out. You'll ship a thing on a weekend because you couldn't stop thinking about it. The day you stop contributing individually is the day this role stops working.

What you'll spend time on:

→ Cross-functional leadership. Drive alignment with engineering, design, marketing, and BD — without managing them. The hardest part of this job is moving a team you don't own toward a north star they help define.

→ Knowing the customer better than anyone in the room. Live in the segment. Talk to users constantly. Understand the social, financial, and behavioural texture of how young Indians live and spend together. Customer obsession isn't a value here, it's a daily practice.

→ Combining insight and analytics to make agile decisions. You move between qualitative signal and quantitative truth fluently. You don't wait for the perfect dashboard, and you don't shoot from the hip. You triangulate.

→ Running the experimentation engine. Define hypotheses, design tests, decide what's instrumented, call results honestly. The team should ship 5–10 experiments a month, and you should be able to defend every one of them.

→ Owning activation and retention. The cohort retention number is the north star. You live with it, and you're accountable for it.

→ Defining what we build — and what we don't. The hardest call in a product like this isn't "what's possible." It's "what's next." That's yours.

→ Building the product team. First hires within 90 days. Roughly five PMs in 12 months. You'll set the bar.

→ Carrying the product story. Internally to leadership, externally to partners, candidates, and the press. The story matters as much as the product.

03

Who we're looking for

The best product leaders we've worked with don't reach for a 2x2 when the road forks. They look at the product, the users, the team — and they have a view. They hold it well. They change it when the evidence shifts. They don't perform conviction. They have it.

They've also never stopped doing the work. They write the spec, they sit in the user interview, they sketch the flow, they argue the metric definition. The title says "lead" but the day-to-day says "builder."

Must-have

→ Built consumer products people use repeatedly. Mobile-first, high-frequency, habit-forming products are ideal.

→ Strong product judgment across insight, UX, metrics, and prioritisation. You can move from user conversations to flows to cohort reads to roadmap calls without outsourcing the hard thinking.

→ Early-stage product instincts. You know the difference between optimising a working funnel and finding the wedge before the funnel exists.

→ Hands-on builder energy. You can write a sharp spec, sketch a flow, run a user interview, define an experiment, and make the call when signal is messy.

→ Ability to build the product function. You've hired, mentored, or raised the bar for PMs before — even if the team was small.

→ Built inside a startup. You've operated in a small, fast-paced team where speed, ambiguity, and direct ownership were the defaults. You don't need structure to do your best work — you create it.

Strong signals

→ You've built a product where growth came from the product loop itself, not just paid marketing.

→ You understand Indian consumer behaviour — especially how young people, couples, flatmates, and families coordinate money.

→ You've worked on social, fintech, commerce, payments, or other coordination-heavy products.

→ You've operated in a regulated or high-trust environment.

→ You use AI tools every day to increase the leverage of a small team.

→ You have unusually strong taste in product, copy, interaction design, and consumer storytelling.

Not required

→ A fintech background.

→ A big-company product title.

→ Experience managing a large PM org.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Toast is building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: running the businesses they love. We've grown into a leading hospitality software company in the U.S., and are now entering our next phase of growth—one defined by scale, complexity, and a new class of enterprise customers.

Every restaurant is unique, and a restaurant's menu expresses its individual brand and product offerings. Inside a Toast restaurant, the definition of the menu becomes the common language between guests, servers, and the kitchen. In our digital ordering products, a great menu serves as both a billboard and a roadmap to an excellent dining experience. It is the central hub for restaurant configuration—it determines what guests can order, how the dishes are presented and priced in different contexts, where they are routed for fulfillment, how they are prepared, whether the ingredients are still available, and how they are classified for reporting.

A menu is always evolving: kitchens create new dishes, managers experiment with pricing and presentation, and staff optimize the menu for restaurant operations. As our customers grow—from single-location cafés to enterprise brands with thousands of locations—so does the complexity of managing these changes consistently, confidently, and at scale.

The Menus team is building for this future. We own the user experiences and APIs that all Toast customers use to manage their menus, the APIs consumed by first- and third-party integrations (like DoorDash and UberEats), and the underlying menu data models that support the full spectrum of restaurant verticals—from Pizzerias to Fine Dining to Retail. We are working to make menus truly enterprise-grade: allowing customers to efficiently audit and manage changes across thousands of locations, while innovating on conversational menu management experiences powered by the Toast IQ platform.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the customer-facing menu management experience. You'll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to craft an experience that helps customers manage their menus with confidence—whether they're rolling out a seasonal menu, updating prices across hundreds of locations, or restructuring their menu to improve kitchen throughput. You'll collaborate closely with a partner menus team based in the US to ensure a coherent and unified product strategy across the menus domain.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Own and evolve the product strategy for Toast's menu management experience, with a focus on:
  • Designing workflows that help customers manage menu changes over time—pricing updates, seasonal rotations, item availability, and structural changes that improve kitchen speed and operational efficiency
  • Building experiences that work for the full spectrum of Toast customers: from owner-operators managing a single location to enterprise teams managing menus across thousands
  • Exploring and integrating automation and AI-assisted ('agentic') workflows into menu configuration and publishing experiences, in partnership with the Toast IQ platform
  • Ensuring coherence across the menus product surface area, in close collaboration with the US-based menus PM and leadership
  • Build and maintain a roadmap in alignment with business OKRs, customer needs, and technical feasibility
  • Drive feature development from ideation through launch—writing clear specs, collaborating with engineering and design, and measuring success
  • In partnership with engineering and design counterparts, contribute to a development team by providing clear direction, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, and accountability

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably with platform or POS products
  • Strong track record of delivering user-facing features in fast-paced environments
  • Analytical rigor—you use data to make decisions and validate assumptions
  • Empathy for restaurants and a passion for improving their day-to-day
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence without authority
  • Experience working cross-functionally and collaborating effectively across time zones

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse, and we embrace that diversity with authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and humility. By embedding these principles into our culture and design, we create equitable opportunities for all and raise the bar in delivering exceptional experiences.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the restaurant community. To learn more about how we work globally and regionally, check out: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.



    • For roles in the United States, it is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager – Web & Apps

Location: Mumbai

Company: Pinkvilla Media Pvt. Ltd.


About Pinkvilla

Pinkvilla is one of India’s leading digital media platforms covering entertainment, lifestyle, and pop culture, reaching millions of users across web and mobile apps. We are building the next generation of content experiences driven by product, data, and innovation.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to work on the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Pinkvilla’s website and mobile applications (iOS & Android). This role requires a strong mix of consumer product thinking, data-driven decision-making, and execution excellence to enhance user engagement, retention, and monetization.


Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Leadership

  • Work with the product team in managing end-to-end product lifecycle for Pinkvilla’s web and app platforms
  • Define and drive the product roadmap aligned with business goals (traffic, engagement, revenue)
  • Identify new opportunities in content consumption, personalization, and user experience

User Experience & Growth

  • Improve user journeys across content discovery, reading, video consumption, and sharing
  • Drive SEO, app engagement, retention, and DAU/MAU growth
  • Optimize funnels (homepage → article → video → subscription/ad engagement)

Data & Analytics

  • Use tools like Google Analytics, Firebase, Mixpanel, etc. to track performance
  • Run A/B tests and experiments to improve conversion and engagement
  • Define and monitor key metrics: retention, session time, bounce rate, CTR

Monetization

  • Work closely with revenue teams to optimize ad placements, page performance, and yield
  • Explore new monetization streams (subscriptions, commerce integrations, branded content formats)

Execution & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, design, editorial, SEO, and sales teams
  • Translate business requirements into clear product requirements (PRDs)
  • Drive sprint planning, prioritization, and timely delivery

Platform & Performance

  • Improve site speed, app performance, and scalability
  • Ensure best practices in Core Web Vitals, app stability, and UX standards


Requirements

Experience

  • 5 - 8+ years in Product Management (preferably in media, content, or consumer internet)
  • Proven experience managing high-traffic websites and mobile apps

Skills

  • Strong understanding of consumer behavior, content platforms, and engagement loops
  • Hands-on with analytics tools (GA4, Firebase, Mixpanel, etc.)

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Delhivery One

Delhivery One is the operating system for India’s SMB and D2C shippers — the single platform through which more than 45,000 SMB and D2C shippers manage their end-to-end logistics every month, for both domestic and international shipping. From creating B2C and B2B orders and managing pickups, to tracking NDRs and RTOs, settling COD remittances, disputing weight mismatches, filing lost and damaged claims, and activating value-added services — Delhivery One handles the full shipper lifecycle across domestic, cross-border, and intracity shipping.

Beyond core shipping, we’ve been doing some exciting work building AI-native value-added services directly on top of Delhivery’s network — things that only work because they’re inside the network, not bolted on from outside. There’s a lot more to build here, and we’d love to have you be part of it.

We are building the best B2B product experience in India for SMB and D2C shippers, and we are doing it AI-first.


The Role

You will own a significant product surface on Delhivery One — spanning core shipper workflows (order management, NDR, finances, claims) and the AI-native value-added services that sit on top of them. Your job is to make both layers exceptional: workflows that are fast, clear, and nearly effortless for an SMB shipper; and AI services that work reliably at scale and get better over time.

This is a high-ownership role. You will define what you build, why, and to what standard — and you will be accountable for the outcomes.


What You Will Do:

Own the shipper experience end-to-end

Define what great looks like for your product area across the full SMB shipper journey — first ship, daily operations, exception handling, billing, claims resolution. Work closely with Design and Engineering to raise the craft bar on every flow. Notice when a workflow has one step too many. Push for better.

Build and ship AI-native features

Design features where AI is the primary mechanism — not a layer bolted on after. Ship them to production, instrument them, and iterate based on real data. Understand confidence thresholds, fallback design, and how to evaluate model quality as a PM.

Set outcome metrics and own them

Define success before you build — activation rate, AI resolution rate, shipper effort score, claim resolution TAT. Treat these as seriously as the features themselves.

Lead cross-functional execution

Drive alignment across Design, Engineering, Finance, Ops, and Business. Write specs that engineers can act on and that leadership can evaluate. Move fast without losing precision.


Is This You?

You have an ownership bias.

When something is broken, you fix it — you don’t wait for someone to assign it to you. You treat the product as if it’s yours, because it is. You follow up, you close loops, and you hold the bar even when no one is watching.

You have an urgency bias.

You move faster than the average PM. You know the difference between “needs more thought” and “we’re overthinking this.” You bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating over waiting for perfect information.

You can go deep without losing the picture.

You can sit in a claims escalation review and understand the edge cases — and then step back and articulate the strategic bet. You don’t get lost in details, and you don’t hide behind strategy to avoid them. You do both.

You have shipped AI-native product work.

Not prototypes. Not internal tools. Features in production where AI is the primary mechanism — and you can talk about what worked, what didn’t, and how you measured it. You understand confidence thresholds, fallback design, and human-in-the-loop tradeoffs.

You have craft for user experience.

You have an aesthetic. You give sharp design feedback and you act on it. You notice when an error message blames the user, when an empty state is a missed opportunity, or when a flow has one step too many — and you do something about it.

You write well.

Your specs don’t require a meeting to understand. You can write a one-pager for a founder and a detailed flow for an engineer, and both leave with clarity.

If this is you, you will thrive here.


What We Are Looking For

4–7 years in Product Management. You have shipped at least one product that real users rely on daily, and you can tell a clear story about the decisions that made it work.

Domain comfort with B2B or logistics complexity is a plus, but not required. What is required is the ability to get up to speed fast — by talking to SMB shippers, digging into ops workflows, and building mental models quickly.

descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of our clients
Industry: Software Development

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Min Experience: 4+ years

Location: Bengaluru

JobType: full-time

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

You will work at the intersection of academic complexity and intuitive product design, translating the needs of administrators, faculty, and students into features that genuinely transform how institutions operate. You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, customer success, and sales to deliver a product that resonates with institutions across India and beyond.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Take full ownership of and continuously enhance the product roadmap for the Academics vertical, encompassing aspects such as attendance, timetabling, curriculum management, course registration, class creation, LMS, feedback, surveys, and PhD/research modules
  • Prioritize features and improvements by integrating customer feedback, usage analytics, and current higher education institutional trends
  • Effectively balance immediate customer demands with the long-term vision for the platform, ensuring that all decisions support our growth goals
  • Lead regular discovery sessions with academic administrators, faculty members, and students from partner institutions to identify pain points and unmet requirements
  • Evaluate product usage data, support inquiries, and market insights to uncover gaps and new opportunities for products within the academics vertical
  • Collaborate closely with customer success and sales teams to incorporate the customer’s perspective into every sprint and planning session
  • Convert complex academic workflows into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user stories that engineering and design teams can confidently implement
  • Facilitate agile processes including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of high-quality releases
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts across design, engineering, QA, and go-to-market teams to guarantee smooth launches of new features
  • Track adoption, engagement, and outcome metrics following product launches and rapidly iterate based on data and user feedback
  • Maintain a well-organized product backlog, prioritizing tasks that have the greatest impact
  • Serve as the main product liaison for academic module stakeholders, both internally (sales, customer success, engineering) and externally (institutional administrators and faculty)
  • Consistently communicate product progress, roadmap priorities, and release schedules clearly to leadership and cross-functional team members



Requirements
Must Haves

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in product management within enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a proven history of delivering B2B SaaS products from start to finish
  • Demonstrated capability to independently manage a product vertical—from initial discovery and roadmap development through execution and post-launch refinement
  • Deep understanding of academic workflows in higher education, including timetabling, curriculum management, learning management systems, attendance, and student lifecycle processes
  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, comfortable utilizing product analytics tools and translating data into actionable product enhancements
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to align cross-functional teams around a unified product vision
  • Practical experience working in agile environments, conducting sprint ceremonies, and managing product backlogs



Good to Have

  • Previous experience collaborating with Indian higher education institutions such as universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms like Moodle, Canvas, or proprietary systems, as well as academic ERP solutions
  • Experience using product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or equivalents
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Figma
  • Background in working with customer-facing teams—including sales, support, and customer success—to collect and act upon institutional feedback
  • A passion for the education sector and a sincere interest in enhancing outcomes for students and academic institutions



Must-have skills

Product Manager, Product Roadmapping, SaaS

Good-to-have skills

B2B, LMS, ERP

title: Senior Product Manager, Subscribe & Save, Subscribe & Save
descriptionHtml:
Description

Amazon Subscribe and Save (SnS) is seeking a product leader to shape SnS’ customer experience product strategy by defining and building Customer-facing experiences across Amazon.com. SnS’ vision is to be the most valued and trusted reorder program in the world, improving customers’ lives by saving them time and money. SnS has grown rapidly, and we are expanding the program across new technologies and customer needs. Millions of customers depend on SnS today, and the experiences you build will enable SnS to serve millions more.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will develop a long-term roadmap of ideas that enhance customers’ interactions with SnS, assisting them in automating their purchases of everyday essentials and building features that make SnS more flexible and intelligent. We own the end-to-end customer experience, from discovery of SnS on Amazon.com all the way to package delivery. As a result, SnS Product Managers build features across the full Amazon.com shopping journey, giving you exposure to many different customer problems and software stacks. You will work with a dedicated team of SnS Software Engineers, User Experience Designers, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Data Scientists who will help bring your ideas to life. You will also design features that support easy reordering outside of SnS.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong product management background, demonstrate a passion for working on behalf of customers, have a track record of partnering with engineering teams to deliver large-scale projects, and have the ability to operate independently and autonomously. This candidate will be able to navigate ambiguity and set a clear vision for how to build an engaging SnS experience that customers love.

Customers are shifting their purchases of everyday essentials online and are increasingly relying on product subscription services in the process. SnS is at the forefront of both of these customer trends – come join us in simplifying the shopping experience for customers around the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: AI - Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Role: AI - Senior Product Manager

Department: AI Products

Location: Bangalore [In-Office]

Type: Fulltime

YOE: 7+ Years



About us :

Established in 2015, ClickPost is Asia’s fastest-growing Logistics Intelligence Platform, dedicated to enhancing post-purchase experiences for retail brands. With seamless integration with over 500+ carriers, we empower leading retailers across India, including 6 Unicorns, to manage 120+ logistics partners via a single API gateway. Backed by Times Internet, Rebright Partners, and other marquee investors, we have achieved profitability and experienced exponential growth, expanding 10x in the past 2 years.


Role Overview:

  • We are seeking an experienced AI - Senior Product Manager to define product vision, roadmap, and execution strategy for AI-powered products, translating business problems into scalable AI solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building and executing new initiatives and roadmaps, understanding market dynamics, and creating business cases for product opportunities.
  • Additionally, they will scale existing products, drive feature adoption, and enhance the overall product experience through data-driven insights and experimentation.


What you will do :

  • Define product vision, roadmap, and execution strategy for AI-powered products, translating business problems into scalable AI solutions.
  • Work closely with engineering, data science, design, and GTM teams to deliver high-impact AI features from concept to launch.
  • Own product discovery by identifying customer pain points, validating opportunities, and prioritizing initiatives using data and user feedback.
  • Drive AI model adoption, performance, and business outcomes through experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimization.
  • Stay current with advancements in AI/LLMs and convert emerging technologies into practical product capabilities that create measurable customer value.
  • Manage product launches end to end with beta customers and internal teams
  • Conduct customer interviews and gather insights to inform feature releases and customization requests.
  • Advocate for cross-sell and upsell opportunities to drive business growth.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and customer facing teams to deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Establish strong team culture and lead squad sprints, setting responsibilities, and reviewing deliverables.


What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • 5+ years of hands-on product management experience across Product, AI/ML, or Technical Product roles, with a proven track record of building and scaling production-grade enterprise AI products.
  • Understanding in modern AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, embeddings, prompt engineering, AI orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
  • A relentless growth mindset with a strong bias for action
  • Demonstrated success in leading Enterprise/B2B product launches from concept to market.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, prioritization, and long-term roadmap creation skills.
  • Industry experience and familiarity with AI, UI design, APIs, and web/mobile application architectures.
  • In-depth understanding of the E-commerce ecosystem, funnels, agile methodologies, and product documentation.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, adept at transforming broad ideas into actionable plans.
  • Empathetic towards users and colleagues, creative, and enthusiastic about innovation.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in relevant field; preference for Computer Science background.
  • If you meet the qualifications and are passionate about driving product innovation in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to lead our product team.


Perks & Benefits:

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Competitive salary package with performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Flexible working hours with Hybrid work arrangement.
  • Generous vacation and time off.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Employee assistance program for mental health and well-being support.
  • Supportive and inclusive work culture promoting diversity and collaboration.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce Revenue Cloud offers fully integrated revenue lifecycle management tools, including CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), Catalog Management, Business Rules Engine, Order Management, Asset Management, Billing, and Contract Lifecycle Management. We are one of a few leading companies in the enterprise CLM software category. We have a talented team with unmatched cloud computing and domain experience and a culture of ownership, delivery, and innovation.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager candidate to join our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) team, as part of Salesforce Revenue Cloud. You will have the opportunity to work on a next-generation, AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management platform that is comprehensive (end-to-end authoring, negotiation, execution, and obligation management), intelligent (powered by Einstein AI and Agentforce for autonomous contract intelligence), scalable (supporting enterprise sell-side and buy-side contracting), and addresses the contract management needs of multiple industries.

You are expected to bring in a stellar product sense and a proven track record in outstanding 0-to-1 execution. You'll also prioritize kindness in your collaboration and be excellent at bringing a team together to rally around a common goal. You'll create, share, and drive strategic vision and execution for products new and old that are loved by their users.

Responsibilities

  • Drive growth in Revenue Cloud by building CLM features to support key enterprise customer needs across contract authoring, negotiation, execution, amendments, and renewals.
  • Own the product vision for Salesforce Contracts. Be an expert on CLM use cases, legal operations domain, and the competitive landscape.
  • Define and drive the AI strategy for contracts — including clause intelligence, contract playbooks, AI-assisted redlining, and Agentforce-powered contract agents.
  • Collaborate with UX and the technology team to develop, test, and deliver assets to engineering — from clause library design to document generation workflows.
  • Evangelize the vision to customers, team, and stakeholders and ensure that it aligns with the overall Revenue Cloud and company vision.
  • Build and deliver a roadmap that excites customers and colleagues alike by building a well-defined backlog spanning contract authoring, negotiation, compliance, and analytics.
  • Partner closely with adjacent product teams (CPQ, Billing, Document Generation, Data Cloud, Agentforce) to deliver a seamless quote-to-contract-to-cash experience.
  • Manage and expand relationships between Product and Engineering teams to deliver world-ready products and internationally applicable features including multi-language contracts and regional compliance.
  • Embrace a culture that measures and rewards customer adoption and success. Define what success means for everything you release before it's built. Develop ways to consistently define and monitor success.

Role Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management or equivalent experience in the Enterprise B2B SaaS.
  • Proven track record of prototyping and launching innovative and user-centered products.
  • Deep understanding of contract management workflows — authoring, clause negotiation, redlining, approval routing, e-signature, amendments, and renewals.
  • Experience with AI/ML product development — ideally in the context of NLP, document intelligence, or generative AI applied to legal/contract workflows.
  • Experience presenting to executives and handling sensitive customer situations.
  • Familiarity with legal operations, compliance frameworks, and enterprise procurement processes.
  • Experience in agile methodologies and working with scrum teams.
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and foundational understanding of computer science.
  • Ability to lead and work autonomously.
  • Strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce platform, Revenue Cloud, or CRM ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with CLM industry leaders (Agiloft, Icertis, Ironclad, Conga) and competitive positioning.
  • Understanding of Enterprise Contract Lifecycle Management, Legal Tech, or Document Automation software
  • Background in enterprise integration patterns — connecting CLM to CRM, ERP, and procurement systems.
  • Experience with data-driven product decisions using analytics platforms.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Product Manager, Search Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with the use of AI for automation.
  • Experience in navigating product and technology trade-offs.
  • Experience leading products while understanding the end user habits.
  • Experience in a fast-paced environment with nuances of managing high traffic, serving binaries, and making product fundamentals.
  • Experience working with technical product leaders and senior engineers, with the ability to influence resourcing, tech, and product decisions.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role, the team is responsible for ensuring that Search delivers on its goals of latency, capacity, and reliability.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Define ideas and execute key goals for search serving binaries and ML infrastructure in collaboration with engineering leadership.
  • Meet the high-compute demands of next-generation AI features.
  • Drive full automation of search binary operations using AI to minimize manual toil.
  • Anticipate future infrastructure needs and manage cross-functional partnerships to build a resilient, future-proof search stack.
  • Build knowledge to bridge the gap between user-centric feature teams and infrastructure reliability.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Senior Product Manager - AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Life at EvoluteIQ


We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry-leading Technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.


To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self-driven, and collaborative.

People who not only want to be a part of a fast-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and caring—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.


Could that be you?


Your Mission

Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble, and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a “dent in the universe”. Our core fabric is Innovation!


And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.


Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive for every day at EvoluteIQ.


To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge. We make the building of automations implemented for everyone, so that it is not a mystery for a few.


Would you like to join us on this journey?


We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our AI/ML feature within our platform. This role requires strong prior experience in AI/ML product development in a product-based environment, with at least 10+ years of hands on- product management experience.


What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:


End-to-End Feature Ownership

  • Own the complete lifecycle of AI/ML features from ideation to production release.
  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering, and data science teams.
  • Drive roadmap definition, prioritization, and delivery planning for AI/ML capabilities.
  • Ensure delivered features meet business objectives, quality benchmarks, and user needs.
  • Drive post release- assessment and iteration based on usage data and feedback.


Research & Requirements Gathering

  • Conduct research on AI/ML industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
  • Identify high-value use cases and business opportunities across domains.
  • Work closely with internal/external stakeholders to understand business problems and define scope.
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable functional requirements and success metrics.
  • Evaluate feasibility, impact, and business value of proposed AI/ML features.
  • Stay informed about developments in Generative AI, LLMs, and emerging tools.


Documentation & Communication

  • Create comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), functional specifications, and workflows.
  • Write detailed user stories with acceptance criteria and test scenarios.
  • Maintain documentation on feature scope, functionality, limitations, design decisions, and usage guidelines.
  • Present feature proposals, roadmap updates, and delivery progress to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Ensure alignment of product expectations across technical and business teams.


Engineering & Delivery Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, data science, UX, DevOps, QA, and architecture teams to deliver high quality- features.
  • Ensure seamless integration of AI/ML workflows and model lifecycle management.
  • Partner with data science to assess model fit, evaluation metrics, and deployment readiness.
  • Support delivery planning, grooming, sprint execution, and release cycles.
  • Coordinate go-to- market activities, enablement, and user training


What will you bring to the team?


  • 12+ years of hands-on product management experience, with proven ownership of AI/ML or GenAI product areas.
  • Prior experience working in a product company is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • ML lifecycle, inference, evaluations
  • MLOps processes, Data engineering concepts
  • LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering
  • Strong documentation skills — PRDs, user stories, specs, and roadmaps.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and data science teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management.
  • Experience with agile methodologies.


Good To Have:

  • Experience with low-code/no-code platforms or enterprise workflow systems.
  • Experience running experiments (A/B testing) or evaluating GenAI/ML models.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next-gen hyper-automation platform.
  • Work with a cross-disciplinary team in a fast-growing, innovation-driven environment.
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.
  • A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.


We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes.

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

You'll own one of the platform layers that powers agentic automation. This is a layer that every other product on the platform - agents, workflows, and RPA - depends on to do its job. Your charter is to make it the obvious, trusted choice for developers and customers in the agentic era, and to prove that value with real production adoption.

This is a hands-on role that pairs high autonomy with high accountability. You will set the vision, own the roadmap, get into the technical design with engineering, sit in customer conversations directly, and carry your story all the way into the field.

The platform you'll shape

You'll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath's agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on.

  • Data Fabric - the data and context layer. Gives agents and workflows governed, real-time access to enterprise data, modeling raw records into business entities and a shared semantic layer automations can reason over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate.
  • Human-in-the-Loop - the human-judgment layer. Whenever an agent, process, or workflow needs a person to review, approve, or handle an exception, it brings the right human in: designing the review interface, routing the task, and delivering it wherever people work. The work ahead: making it first-class for the agentic era.

What You'll Do At UiPath

  • Own the vision and roadmap for your platform layer, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems, and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
  • Drive go-to-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
  • Be the customer's champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.
  • Own outcomes end to end. Take accountability from problem definition through launch, adoption, and the metrics that prove value (e.g. production adoption, task success rate, agent reliability).
  • Get technical. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering on design decisions, dogfood the product yourself, and stay credible on the underlying technology.
  • Make it agent-ready. Translate the fast-moving agent landscape (LLMs, coding agents, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.
  • Raise the bar for the broader product team through thought leadership, a strong point of view in forums, and mentoring.

What You'll Bring To The Team

  • 8+ years of product management on technical / platform / developer products, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
  • A builder's instinct. You've shipped infrastructure that other builders rely on, and you'd rather prototype and dogfood than write a spec and wait.
  • Technical depth. You go deep on technical design with engineering and are comfortable in the product yourself, not just managing from the roadmap.
  • Hands-on with AI, not conceptual. You have built or integrated AI/ML into live products yourself, and you use LLM-based tools (copilots, coding agents, prototyping tools) in your own daily work. Building products for - and with - agents is a fundamental expectation.
  • A genuine customer-champion mindset. You seek out direct customer conversations and let real scenarios drive what you build.
  • GTM drive. You've created demand and driven adoption, not just delivered features - and you can tell a clear "why" and "what" story to any audience.
  • Crisp, decision-rich communication and the ability to influence across engineering, design, sales, and marketing without authority.
  • Bias to ownership and action - you take ambiguous, high-stakes problems and drive them to a result with minimal direction.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with data platforms or human-in-the-loop / workflow systems.
  • Built or shipped products in the agentic / AI space.
  • Background that combines engineering and product.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. descriptionText:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

You'll own one of the platform layers that powers agentic automation. This is a layer that every other product on the platform - agents, workflows, and RPA - depends on to do its job. Your charter is to make it the obvious, trusted choice for developers and customers in the agentic era, and to prove that value with real production adoption.

This is a hands-on role that pairs high autonomy with high accountability. You will set the vision, own the roadmap, get into the technical design with engineering, sit in customer conversations directly, and carry your story all the way into the field.

The platform you'll shape

You'll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath's agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on.



- Data Fabric - the data and context layer. Gives agents and workflows governed, real-time access to enterprise data, modeling raw records into business entities and a shared semantic layer automations can reason over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate.
- Human-in-the-Loop - the human-judgment layer. Whenever an agent, process, or workflow needs a person to review, approve, or handle an exception, it brings the right human in: designing the review interface, routing the task, and delivering it wherever people work. The work ahead: making it first-class for the agentic era.

What You'll Do At UiPath



- Own the vision and roadmap for your platform layer, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems, and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
- Drive go-to-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
- Be the customer's champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.
- Own outcomes end to end. Take accountability from problem definition through launch, adoption, and the metrics that prove value (e.g. production adoption, task success rate, agent reliability).
- Get technical. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering on design decisions, dogfood the product yourself, and stay credible on the underlying technology.
- Make it agent-ready. Translate the fast-moving agent landscape (LLMs, coding agents, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.
- Raise the bar for the broader product team through thought leadership, a strong point of view in forums, and mentoring.

What You'll Bring To The Team



- 8+ years of product management on technical / platform / developer products, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
- A builder's instinct. You've shipped infrastructure that other builders rely on, and you'd rather prototype and dogfood than write a spec and wait.
- Technical depth. You go deep on technical design with engineering and are comfortable in the product yourself, not just managing from the roadmap.
- Hands-on with AI, not conceptual. You have built or integrated AI/ML into live products yourself, and you use LLM-based tools (copilots, coding agents, prototyping tools) in your own daily work. Building products for - and with - agents is a fundamental expectation.
- A genuine customer-champion mindset. You seek out direct customer conversations and let real scenarios drive what you build.
- GTM drive. You've created demand and driven adoption, not just delivered features - and you can tell a clear "why" and "what" story to any audience.
- Crisp, decision-rich communication and the ability to influence across engineering, design, sales, and marketing without authority.
- Bias to ownership and action - you take ambiguous, high-stakes problems and drive them to a result with minimal direction.

Nice To Have



- Experience with data platforms or human-in-the-loop / workflow systems.
- Built or shipped products in the agentic / AI space.
- Background that combines engineering and product.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
